title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.8.11
body_markdown:
*released June 11th, 2024*

### Summary of What's New in this release

* After upgrading to Germanium build of Windows, WSL requires a manual upgrade. This can cause Visual Studio to hang when opening CMake projects.
* Fixed a bug in the PDB reading code to ignore expected failures in certain FASTLINK PDBs.

### Developer Community

* [Error: Unable to open file (null). Error code = 0x0000000D](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Error:-Unable-to-open-file-null-Error/10610474)
* [C++/CLI C++20: fatal error C1001: Internal compiler error (static initonly array)](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/CCLI-C20:-fatal-error-C1001:-Intern/10594174)

### Security advisories addressed

* [**CVE-2024-30052**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-30052) Remote Code Execution when debugging dump files that contain a malicious file with an appropriate extension
* [**CVE-2024-29060**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-29060) Elevation of Privilege where affected installation of Visual Studio is running
* [**CVE-2024-29187**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2024-29187) WiX based installers are vulnerable to binary hijack when run as SYSTEM
